title: Death Toll Rises to 17 Following Explosion at Turkish Steel Plant
subtitle: Authorities continue search operations as questions grow regarding workplace safety standards in Turkey.

summary.en: A deadly explosion at the Habas steel plant in Aliaga has resulted in 17 deaths. The incident occurred when a crane collapsed into a furnace during maintenance work. Officials have confirmed that search and rescue operations are still ongoing at the site. The tragedy has sparked intense criticism from opposition groups regarding industrial safety. Authorities have now arrested five people as part of an official investigation.
summary.zh: 位於阿里亞加的哈巴斯鋼鐵廠發生致命爆炸，造成十七人死亡。事故起因於維護作業期間，起重機倒塌墜入熔爐。官員證實現場搜救行動仍在持續。這場悲劇引發反對派團體對工業安全的強烈批評。當局目前已逮捕五人，並展開正式調查。

paragraphs.en: The death toll from a massive explosion at a major steel factory in western Turkey has risen to 17, according to government officials. Health Minister Kemal Memişoğlu confirmed that one of the workers, who was initially in critical condition, passed away in the hospital. This update follows the earlier report of 16 deaths and 13 injuries caused by the accident at the Habas Demir Celik plant in the port city of Aliaga.
paragraphs.zh: 根據政府官員表示，土耳其西部一家大型鋼鐵廠發生嚴重爆炸，死亡人數已攀升至十七人。衛生部長梅米索盧（Kemal Memişoğlu）證實，其中一名原本情況危急的工人已在醫院不治身亡。在此之前，位於阿里亞加（Aliaga）港口城市的哈巴斯鋼鐵廠（Habas Demir Celik）發生事故，當時報導指出造成十六人死亡、十三人受傷。

paragraphs.en: According to the local governor, Süleyman Elban, the explosion occurred around midday during scheduled maintenance work on an electric arc furnace. Reports from the governor’s office and other officials indicate that an overhead crane carrying a heavy replacement boiler collapsed, causing materials to fall into the furnace below. At the time of the accident, the factory was in the middle of a shift change, meaning fewer people were on-site than during normal production hours. Approximately 200 workers were present when the blast took place.
paragraphs.zh: 根據當地省長埃爾班（Süleyman Elban）的說法，爆炸發生在中午左右，當時工廠正在進行電弧爐的定期維護作業。省長辦公室及其他官員的報告指出，一台吊掛著重型替換鍋爐的架空起重機發生倒塌，導致物體掉落至下方的熔爐中。事故發生時，工廠正處於輪班交接期間，因此現場人數比正常生產時段少，爆炸發生時約有兩百名工人在場。

paragraphs.en: Eyewitnesses described the moment of the explosion as terrifying. Some people in the surrounding area reported that the ground shook so violently they initially believed an earthquake had struck the region. Following the blast, a large fire broke out, and a thick column of smoke was seen rising into the air. While the local mayor, Cemil Tugay, confirmed that the fire has since been put out, search and rescue teams remain at the site to clear the debris. Officials have expressed concerns that the final death toll could still rise as teams search for people who may be trapped under the rubble.
paragraphs.zh: 目擊者形容爆炸發生的瞬間令人恐懼。周邊地區的一些民眾表示，地面震動得非常劇烈，他們起初以為該地區發生了地震。爆炸後，現場燃起大火，濃煙直衝天際。雖然當地市長圖蓋（Cemil Tugay）證實火勢已被撲滅，但搜救隊仍留在現場清理殘骸。官員們擔憂，隨著搜救隊持續搜尋可能受困於瓦礫堆下的人員，最終死亡人數恐將進一步增加。

paragraphs.en: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan addressed the incident after a cabinet meeting, confirming that investigations are currently underway. The Ministry of Justice has assigned four public prosecutors to handle the case, and BBC News reports that at least five people have been arrested in connection with the disaster. Interior Minister Mustafa Ciftci stated that the injured workers are being closely monitored in local hospitals.
paragraphs.zh: 總統艾爾段（Recep Tayyip Erdoğan）在內閣會議後針對此事件發表談話，證實目前調查工作正在進行中。司法部已指派四名檢察官負責處理此案，BBC新聞報導指出，至少已有五人因這起災難遭到逮捕。內政部長奇夫奇（Mustafa Ciftci）表示，受傷工人的狀況正受到當地醫院的密切監控。

paragraphs.en: This tragedy has brought renewed attention to the issue of workplace safety in Turkey. The Turkish Health and Safety Labor Watch, an independent organization that tracks industrial accidents, noted that workplace deaths remain a chronic problem in the country. To provide context, the organization highlighted that there were 226 workplace deaths reported across Turkey in September alone. They noted that this figure is roughly two-thirds of the total number of workplace deaths recorded in Germany—a country with a similar population size—during the entire year of 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 這場悲劇讓土耳其的職場安全問題再次受到關注。追蹤工業事故的獨立組織「土耳其勞工健康與安全觀察站」指出，職場死亡事故在該國仍是長期存在的問題。該組織強調，僅在九月份，土耳其全國就通報了兩百二十六起職場死亡案例。他們指出，這個數字大約是人口規模相近的德國在二〇二五年全年職場死亡總數的三分之二。

paragraphs.en: Opposition groups have reacted strongly to the news. The leftist opposition party, TIP, described the event as "workplace homicide," arguing that the government and factory owners do not take safety regulations seriously enough. TIP leader Erkan Bas stated that the current system prioritizes profit over the lives of workers, while union leader Basaran Aksu called for the resignation of the minister of labor. These voices argue that the disaster was not an isolated incident but a result of a system that fails to protect its employees.
paragraphs.zh: 反對派團體對此消息反應強烈。左翼反對黨「土耳其工人黨」（TIP）將此事件描述為「職場謀殺」，主張政府與工廠經營者並未認真看待安全法規。該黨領袖巴斯（Erkan Bas）表示，現行體制將利潤置於工人生命之上，而工會領袖阿克蘇（Basaran Aksu）則要求勞動部長下台。這些聲音認為，這場災難並非單一事件，而是體制未能保護員工所導致的結果。

paragraphs.en: The Habas plant is one of Turkey’s leading steel producers and serves as a major hub for the shipbreaking industry. Established in 1987, the facility is capable of producing 4.5 million tons of steel annually. As the investigation continues, the focus remains on how such a significant failure in safety equipment could occur at such a large and established facility. For now, the families of the victims and the local community are waiting for more information as the search for survivors slowly concludes.
paragraphs.zh: 哈巴斯鋼鐵廠是土耳其主要的鋼鐵生產商之一，也是拆船工業的重要樞紐。該設施成立於一九八七年，每年可生產四百五十萬噸鋼鐵。隨著調查持續進行，焦點仍集中在為何如此大型且老牌的設施會發生如此嚴重的安全設備故障。目前，受害者家屬與當地社區正等待更多消息，而搜救工作也已進入尾聲。

quiz.question: What specifically triggered the explosion at the Habas Demir Celik plant?

options.A: A failure in the electric arc furnace's power supply.
options.B: An overhead crane dropping a heavy boiler into the furnace.
options.C: A shift change error that caused the furnace to overheat.
options.D: A structural collapse of the factory floor during maintenance.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，州長辦公室的報告明確指出，事故原因是起重機在搬運重型鍋爐時發生坍塌，導致零件掉落進下方的電弧爐中，進而引發爆炸。選項 A 提到的電力供應問題文中未提及；選項 C 雖提到換班，但換班是時間背景而非爆炸原因；選項 D 雖然提到坍塌，但坍塌的是起重機吊掛的物體，而非工廠地板。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the final death toll increase?

options.A: Because the hospital lacks the necessary equipment to treat the injured.
options.B: Because the fire is still burning and spreading to other parts of the factory.
options.C: Because rescue teams are still searching through the debris for trapped individuals.
options.D: Because the government has not yet sent enough medical personnel to the site.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到，雖然火勢已撲滅，但搜救隊仍在現場清理瓦礫，且官方擔心在瓦礫堆下可能還有失蹤者，因此死亡人數可能會增加。選項 A 文中未提及醫院設備不足；選項 B 與文中提到的「火勢已撲滅」矛盾；選項 D 屬於無中生有的推測，文中並未提及醫療人員不足的問題。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, the word "chronic" is used to describe workplace deaths in Turkey. What does it mean in this context?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在醫學上，「chronic」指慢性疾病，在此處用來形容工業事故，意指這是一個長期存在、反覆發生的社會問題。選項 B 「突發的」與慢性病的持續性相反；選項 C 「微不足道的」與文中強調這是一個嚴重的社會議題不符；選項 D 「容易解決的」與「長期問題」的定義完全背道而馳。
